title: Speed rush adds an optional peripheral blur at riding speed
summary: An authored seven-sample radial effect now eases in at 40 mph and caps at 75 mph, keeping the projected rider and center sharp while adding a subtle peripheral streak and bounded warp.
details: Desktop host verification passed across 357 rendered samples: center pixels were unchanged, the edge region showed 3,125,724 changed pixels, and Off matched the untouched frame exactly. Real riding at 47 mph and an airborne active frame were checked.

Saved Off/Low/Normal/High choices, preference reload, and WebGL context recovery passed. The effect skips work below threshold, during crashes and menus, or when disabled; it does not use camera turns or previous frames. Reduced-motion defaults to Off unless the player saved a choice.

Portrait 390×844 verification also passed across 400 rendered samples, including two airborne active frames and native riding driven in four-input batches. Center pixels stayed unchanged, edge changes were 3,125,724, Off matched exactly, and saved settings/context restoration passed.
limitation: Host desktop and portrait verification only; public deployment and verification are pending. The effect is an authored optional enhancement, not recovered original behavior.
